From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: procurement@NimbusRetail.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Support vendor alignment & Gainsight pilot proposal

Team —

Quick background: Nimbus has asked us to recommend a consolidated support + success stack for their retail operations. They currently run Intercom for real-time chat, Zendesk for ticketing, and no dedicated CSM tooling. They want a single vendor for easier procurement and a pilot to validate success workflows.

I attached a short cost/usage extract (Intercom_cost_analysis_Q3.xlsx) and the draft Gainsight pilot scope (Gainsight_pilot_scope.pdf). High-level asks:
- Can Marcus and Rishi run a feature/cost delta between Intercom + Zendesk vs. Zendesk + Gainsight by EOD Thu?
- Laura, can you outline the top 3 CS requirements that would make a Gainsight pilot worthwhile (playbooks, health scoring, onboarding automation)?
- Sofia, please coordinate scheduling with Nimbus procurement and include legal for the trial terms.

Goal: get stakeholder consensus and sign a 60-day pilot for Gainsight while we validate whether chat/ticket consolidation is worth moving off Intercom.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Intercom_cost_analysis_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet, summary tab)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Support vendor alignment & Gainsight pilot proposal

Kimberly — thanks, saw the attachments. Quick notes after a cursory pass:

- Cost: Intercom chat seats + custom routing is currently ~35% of Nimbus's support spend; Zendesk seats are cheaper for high-volume ticketing. I've started a cost matrix (will attach vendor_rfp_responses.zip when complete).
- Integrations: Gainsight can ingest Zendesk tickets natively; Intercom sync will require additional middleware (we estimate ~3-4 week integration effort).
- Latency/UX: None of the vendors will materially improve customer-facing chat latency; Intercom is still best-in-class for chat widgets.

Action items I will own: produce a side-by-side feature + TCO table (licensed, integration, third-party middleware) and an ops migration effort estimate by Thu COB.

On the Gainsight front — agree with pilot idea if the scope is narrow (onboarding + playbook automation). If Nimbus requires full ticketing replacement in pilot, we should push back.

—Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Support vendor alignment & Gainsight pilot proposal

Thanks — I'm copying in the CS perspective so procurement has context. TL;DR: I support a Gainsight pilot focused on onboarding/playbooks + Zendesk for ticketing retention. Reasons:

1) Gainsight strength: playbooks + automated outreach will dramatically reduce manual handoffs in onboarding and mid-funnel retention. We can clearly measure NPS and time-to-first-value in 60 days.
2) Ticketing parity: Zendesk's macros and bulk operations still beat Intercom for high-volume ticket triage (we'd lose efficiency if we moved 100% to Intercom for tickets).
3) Risk: switching chat vendor mid-holiday season = risk. If Nimbus wants full consolidation, run it in Q1 with a phased migration.

Proposed pilot scope (concise):
- 60 days, Gainsight + Zendesk integration for 2 product lines (pilot cohort = 5k customers)
- Success metrics: onboarding completion rate, reduction in manual escalations, CS workload reduction (FTE delta)
- Implementation leads: Gainsight PM (external), Marcus (integration), Laura (CS playbooks)

If procurement signs off, let's lock dates: kickoff week Nov 22 and initial readiness review Nov 30.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
